status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Inlined into server.mjs by esbuild because neither is published: the engine is an unpublished candidate, and the comparison is TypeScript in the site repository. Bundling is what keeps one copy of the comparison rules rather than two.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned draft vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard.

changedSince: rc.1 through rc.4 are unchanged and still downloadable; this is a separate immutable archive. Since rc.4 the executable bundle differs only in the version string it reports. What changed is the install instructions, and they were unsafe: the README printed the archive digest with `shasum` and left the reader to compare it by eye, with the extract and install steps on unguarded lines below. A tampered archive therefore extracted, installed, and passed `npm run verify` — which tests that the server behaves, not that these are the published bytes. The developer page now publishes a block that compares the digest and stops before extracting on any mismatch, incomplete download, or destination collision, and this README no longer presents an unguarded sequence.
